postTitle: Invest or Pay Off Debt? The Math and the Sequence
topic: An employer match can be a 100% return on the matched euros

assumptions.notes: Employer match of up to 100% on contributions up to a cap (common in US 401(k) style plans; elsewhere employer contributions may be fixed by law or absent). Card 22%. Investing about 7% a year before inflation, long run average for diversified equities, not guaranteed (blog: 6 to 8%). Mortgage 3.4%, about 2.6% effective after partial tax relief where it exists, per the blog's worked example; relief varies by country.
